effects.description: [Blocker] (After your opponent declares an attack, you may rest this card to make it the new target of the attack.)
steps: (Optional) Rest this card to change the attack target to this Character
notes: You can only use this effect when your opponent declares an attack
You don't have to use this effect — it's your choice
After using this effect, this card becomes rested

effects.description: [DON!! x1] [On Block] Play up to 1 red Character card with a cost of 2 or less from your hand.
conditions: You are using this Character to block an attack
This Character has at least 1 DON!! card attached
You have a red Character card in your hand that costs 2 or less
steps: (Optional) Play 1 red Character card from your hand that costs 2 or less onto your field
notes: This effect activates when this Character blocks an attack and has 1 DON!! attached
You can choose not to play any card even if you have one
The played Character enters the field immediately without cost
